title: Practice 15: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: I can remember it very vividly.
exercises.why: **помнить → помню** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: The police are following us.
exercises.why: **преследовать → преследует** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: How do you manage to do this?
exercises.why: **получаться → получается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: All the industries in the city are booming.
exercises.why: **процветать → процветают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: This country is really going to the dogs!
exercises.why: **катиться → катится** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ит belongs to the second (и) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: This door locks by itself.
exercises.why: **замыкаться → замыкается** — present-type form, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Fortune favors the bold.
exercises.why: **привечать → привечает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I'm not throwing anything away.
exercises.why: **выбрасывать → выбрасываю** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: My skin is almost touching yours.
exercises.why: **соприкасаться → соприкасается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Lions are colorblind.
exercises.why: **различать → различают** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: He always tells vulgar jokes.
exercises.why: **отпускать → отпускает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Перед принятием важных решений Том всегда ___ (советоваться) со своим астрологом.
exercises.prompt: Before making important decisions, Tom always consults his astrologer.
exercises.why: **советоваться → советуется** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: It's rare for something like this to happen.
exercises.why: **случаться → случается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: One wonders how it's possible.
exercises.why: **спрашиваться → Спрашивается** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: It always takes them so much time...
exercises.why: **копаться → копаются** — present tense, 3rd person plural: ending -ют belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Capitalism is destroying the world.
exercises.why: **разрушать → разрушает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: Are you not exaggerating?
exercises.why: **преувеличивать → преувеличиваешь** — present tense, 2nd person singular: ending -ешь belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.q: Идеализм яростно ___ (воевать) против утверждения марксистской философии о познаваемости мира.
exercises.prompt: Idealism fights furiously against the assertion of Marxist philosophy about the knowability of the world.
exercises.why: **воевать → воюет** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.

exercises.prompt: I doubt if sanctions will work.
exercises.why: **сомневаться → Сомневаюсь** — present tense, 1st person singular.

exercises.prompt: She teaches reading and writing.
exercises.why: **обучать → обучает** — present tense, 3rd person singular: ending -ет belongs to the first (е) conjugation.
